scope: Selected 1,438 lines across six original computational files plus existing test/result artifacts; excludes dependencies, Site code, full repository, continuum physics and exhaustive dynamic/path coverage.

findings.severity: high for nonzero delayed probe experiments
findings.title: Comparison family centered at the wrong probe amplitude
findings.observed: With probe_amp=0.5, old finite differences were centered at zero; gauge and translated runs also dropped the probe. Old field comparison differed by 0.5002586.
findings.impact: False rejection of a valid tangent and comparison of physically different source histories. Default probe_amp=0 is unaffected.
findings.fix: Center plus/minus runs at probe_amp ± epsilon, retain probe in gauge/translated runs, and mark legacy comparison unavailable when its source cannot match.

findings.title: Unvalidated scenario controls yield NaNs or silently select a model
findings.repro: audit_repro.py: zero_epsilon and unknown_mode_accepted; bad-epsilon and mode regressions
findings.observed: Unknown mode misspelled is accepted; epsilon=0 emits NaN derivative arrays. Empty epsilons fail later at min(); duplicate epsilons collapse in CSV mapping.
findings.impact: Invalid diagnostic output or unintended comparison family; no evidence that accepted historical defaults contain this input defect.
findings.fix: Validate mode, nonfinite source controls, supported gauge flag, nonempty distinct positive finite epsilon values before integration. Also reject incomplete/nonfinite returned state arrays.

findings.title: Python optimization can disable mathematical acceptance checks
findings.observed: A deliberately wrong Bloch identity (+1 defect), executed with python -O, returns exit code 0 and passed:false in historical symbolic code. The old aggregate runner checks only exit code.
findings.impact: A future optimized or inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE run could be marked successful despite failed checks. The recorded nonoptimized historical run remains valid.
findings.fix: Replace assert acceptance with explicit exceptions; new aggregate runner requires fresh output, semantic success and unchanged source bytes.

findings.title: Explicit unsafe theorem labels bypass the narrow blacklist
findings.observed: A declared theorem seed labeled proposed or unresolved is accepted and produces status proved.
findings.impact: Metadata inconsistency can be laundered into a trace. This does not show the accepted fixture has unsafe labels, nor can a text-label check establish theorem truth.
findings.fix: Reject the complete reserved unsafe label set after whitespace normalization. Mathematical rule certification remains an external review obligation.

findings.title: Referenced proof bytes are absent from the graph hash
findings.observed: The library hash binds proof_ref strings, not bytes of the referenced theorem and contract documents. A changed document preserves the old library hash.
findings.impact: Stale external derivations could be displayed alongside a valid planning trace. This was a documented planner boundary, now additionally guarded.
findings.fix: New immutable-version evidence manifest binds fixture, planner and local referenced proof files; verify before/after planning, including unchanged manifest digest.
findings.status: provenance guard implemented and mutation tested

findings.title: Exact large integer costs overflow during unnecessary float conversion
findings.observed: Positive integer cost 10**400 raises OverflowError rather than following the documented integer-cost contract.
findings.impact: Input handling defect only; no wrong optimum for accepted ordinary-cost fixtures.
findings.fix: Keep positive Python integer costs exact; remove float conversion.

findings.title: Missing observation windows can be reported as a pass; work window ignores overlapping pump
findings.observed: No pre-probe samples are assigned pre_max=0 and pass; no late samples return infinity. Work constancy is tested after the probe even if the primary pump remains active.
findings.impact: Vacuous causality pass or a false work-identity failure for a permitted pulse arrangement.
findings.fix: Report sample counts and null for unobserved windows; do not pass missing coverage. Begin post-drive work check only after both sources end.

findings.title: Legacy conditional flag can be mistaken for an unconditional theorem
findings.observed: conditional:false means no explicitly retained conjecture, although finite-model hypotheses remain in assumptions.
findings.impact: A UI using only that flag could falsely label the result unconditional.
findings.fix: Emit declared_assumption_ids, conditional_on_declared_assumptions, conjectural_assumptions, conditional_flag_meaning and result_kind. Preserve old fields for compatibility.

findings.title: Scenario source hash was captured only after the computation
findings.observed: Historical source_hash() is evaluated at report assembly, so mid-run changes cannot be distinguished from a run of the reported source.
findings.impact: A general reproducibility gap; all 13 audited historical source/result/contract hashes currently match.
findings.fix: Capture source and imported legacy hashes before scenario execution, compare again before return. Aggregate gate checks its command source before/after execution.

scope_limits: No fresh selected 1024-node trajectory or 2048-node refinement; historical sampled acceptance remains unchanged.
No interval enclosure between samples or proof of continuum regulator removal.
No arbitrary quantum-state tangent, finite-momentum response kernel, quantum noise or curved-spacetime pressure closure implemented.
A checked Horn trace and artifact hashes are not a formal theorem-assistant proof.
Small-b cancellation in the closed digamma expression and adversarial import/process compromise are outside the tested numerical domain.
